scenarios.diagnosis: Checkout saved the order total without its shipping cost, and the confirmation page did not add that cost before showing the final amount.
scenarios.suggestion: Include shipping when the order total is saved, or calculate and display it in the confirmation total so the final amount matches what the customer is charged.
